about.title: Time set aside for the details.
paragraphs: Verdant House treats grooming as quiet, skilled work. Every choice—from the light around the chair to the angle of a line—is considered.
Step away from the noise, settle in, and leave with a cut that feels natural on day one and still holds its shape weeks later.

items.question: Do I need to book in advance?
items.answer: We recommend it. Appointments let every guest have the chair, consultation, and finishing time they need.

items.question: What products do you use?
items.answer: We use professional products selected for different hair textures, finishes, and skin needs.

items.question: How long does a service take?
items.answer: A haircut takes about 45 minutes. Combined hair and beard services usually take 60 to 75 minutes.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Yes. Validated parking is available in the garage two doors east of the studio.
